title: Niti Aayog turns down Tata, M&M, JSW MG’s request on definition of ZEVs - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: Niti Aayog's report expands the definition of ZEVs to include biofuels and other alternatives, rejecting industry pressure to move directly to electric vehicles. The report outlines a phased approach for adopting lower-emission technologies and biofuels, emphasizing a technology-neutral decarbonization pathway.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is positive as the report supports a comprehensive approach to decarbonization that includes a variety of technologies and biofuels, which could potentially lead to a more sustainable and inclusive transition to zero-emission vehicles.
